data.title: Man City skipper confident club will win appeal
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca said Friday he has absolute faith the club will win its appeal after being found guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules.

data.title: Nations from Germany to South Korea in race to host 2036 Olympics
data.description: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) has outlined the next stages in the selection of the host of the 2036 Olympic Games, with seven countries currently in discussions and a final decision expected in mid-2029.

data.title: More than just football: How scandal-tainted City led Manchester's rebirth
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Standing behind the counter of his fish-and-chip shop near the Etihad Stadium, Sailish Parekh says the transformation of east Manchester over the past two decades has been remarkable.

data.title: ONE Championship: Suriyanlek misses weight but Yunusov fight goes ahead at catchweight
data.description: Suriyanlek Por Yenying’s fight with unbeaten Russian Rustam Yunusov will go ahead at catchweight at The Inner Circle 34 on Friday after the Thai missed the flyweight limit by 3.8lb.

data.title: Man City face Anfield cauldron after guilty Premier League verdicts
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester City are set for a hostile reception at Liverpool on Sunday in their first outing since being found guilty of over 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules.

data.title: Mourinho's Real Madrid playing catch-up in Clasico countdown
data.description: MADRID - Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid trail leaders Barcelona by six points as La Liga action resumes this weekend, with Spanish football starting the countdown to the Clasico after the extended international break.

data.title: Ratchanok rolls into QF, faces Sindhu
data.description: Ratchanok Intanon cruised into the women's singles quarter-finals of the US$500,000 Arctic Open 2026 in Vantaa, Finland, on Thursday.

data.title: Golden payday for Nagoya heroes
data.description: Asian Games heroes on Thursday received over 236 million baht in cash bonuses during a special event held in honour of athletes, coaches, and sports associations that brought success to Thailand following their impressive performances at Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: Champs Buriram frustrated by stubborn Borneo at home
data.description: Ten-man Buriram United began their Asean Club Championship Shopee Cup defence with a 0-0 draw against Borneo Samarinda on Wednesday night, while fellow Thai League 1 side Ratchaburi shared a point after a 1-1 home draw with Ho Chi Minh City Police FC.

data.title: Argentina friendlies no fairy tale for African footballers
data.description: ABIDJAN - When Benin and Burkina Faso flew to Buenos Aires for friendlies against Argentina -- including superstar Lionel Messi's swansong-- it would have seemed like dreamland for players who rarely if ever rub shoulders with the aristocrats of the 'Beautiful Game'.

data.title: Rwanda to host F1 Grand Prix: sources close to both sides
data.description: KIGALI - Rwanda will host a Formula One (F1) Grand Prix, sources in the government and close to the sport's governing body told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) Thursday, marking the first race in decades on the African continent.

data.title: Hudson sticks with beaten Thai stars
data.description: Anthony Hudson intends to keep faith with the core of the squad that fell just short in the Fifa Asean Cup, as Thailand's head coach turns his attention to next year's Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia.

data.title: Saysunee gunning for trio of gold
data.description: Five-time Paralympic gold medallist Saysunee Jana will lead the Thai wheelchair fencing team at the 2026 Asian Para Games, while the coaching staff have identified China and South Korea as their key rivals in Aichi-Nagoya from Oct 18-24.

data.title: ONE Championship: Yu Yau Pui eyes Stamp Fairtex fight after finding herself again
data.description: Hong Kong’s Yu Yau Pui would welcome a fight with Thai star Stamp Fairtex as she looks to climb ONE Championship’s atomweight Muay Thai rankings with renewed self-belief after beating Britain’s Marie McManamon.

data.title: ONE Championship: Luke Lessei enters title picture as Carrillo eyes first defence
data.description: Luke Lessei has strengthened his case to challenge Nico Carrillo in his first defence of the undisputed featherweight Muay Thai title, with back-to-back wins arriving as the ONE Championship king targets December.

data.title: Verstappen revival to be put to the test in steamy Singapore
data.description: SINGAPORE - Max Verstappen's resurgence in Malaysia will be put to the test just 300 kilometres south at the Singapore Grand Prix this weekend, where the Red Bull driver may need to overcome the elements and his own poor record at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.

data.title: Aichi governor upset as Thai teqball team complain about food at Asian Games
data.description: Hideaki Ōmura, governor of Aichi Prefecture, has said he is displeased that Thailand's national teqball team posted complaints online about the small food portions at the 2026 Asian Games, suggesting they did it to attract views and that he would rather they did not return.

data.title: Messi signs off in tears after one last Argentina master class
data.description: BUENOS AIRES — Lionel ⁠Messi delivered one ⁠last master class in ​blue and white on Tuesday as Argentina's captain brought the curtain down on his extraordinary 21-year international career by ​scoring one goal and setting up two others ‌in a 3-0 friendly win over Benin.

data.title: Oosterhuis: A giant of game with a sweet 2-iron
data.description: It was a filthy day with non-stop rain pounding the Hilversumsche course and I found myself sitting on a clubhouse couch next to Peter Oosterhuis. Back in 1974, Peter was the man of the moment and was consistently winning tournaments over a ten-year period. We chatted about this and that and he mentioned he was hoping to go out and play, as he was only one shot back. All the other players, who were not in contention, didn't want to go out in the Dutch monsoon. However, the tournament ultimately was reduced to just three rounds and Brian Barnes was declared the winner.

data.title: Thunder Castle open  Shopee Cup defence
data.description: Defending champions Buriram United will kick off their Asean Club Championship Shopee Cup campaign in Group A, taking on Indonesia's Borneo Samarinda on Wednesday.
